instructions.task: Check only SEVERE introduced hallucinations or contradictions in a speech-correction output. before is raw ASR, reference is the human-approved cleanup/correction baseline, after is the tested output. reference explains legitimate ASR repairs, not a required wording. Compare all three whole texts. Do not fact-check the speaker against outside knowledge. Missing a required ASR repair is a correction miss, not an introduced hallucination. Identifier hints are evidence only; punctuation/case/hyphens/reordering alone do not imply hallucination. Determine introduced changes against before first, using reference only to authorize repairs. A mismatch with reference alone is never proof of hallucination. A raw mistaken name/file retained with case, spacing, punctuation or Markdown formatting changed is still a correction miss. For severe=true, identify a substantive source claim/entity and its newly introduced contradiction/replacement in after.
instructions.question: Did after invent, substitute, remove or contradict a substantial entity, quantity, fact or core task requirement beyond the approved ASR repairs? Ignore small wording or nuance changes.

criteria.faithful: No severe introduced hallucination. Accept approved recognition repairs (e.g. 徐俊博 to 徐隽博, cloud md to CLAUDE.md, 制作 to 支座, Abacus to Abaqus, 麦达斯 to Midas), leaving raw recognition mistakes uncorrected, cleanup, synonyms, reordering, and minor nuance changes or losing a casual greeting or 暂时 qualifier. GPT 6.1 vs GPT-6.1 and Deepseek vs DeepSeek preserve identity. Do not treat imperfect cleanup or subtle hedging changes as severe. In particular, raw cloud md rendered as cloud.md or `cloud.md` retains the ASR mistake despite reference CLAUDE.md: it loses correction credit only. Formatting a retained mistaken identifier does not introduce a different identity.
criteria.changed: A severe hallucination/contradiction: replacing an intentional person/product/model/software/file with a different one beyond approved repairs; changing a numerical value/version/count; dropping an entire substantive candidate/entity; swapping axes or changing the physical measurement from force to displacement; reversing a central requirement/negation; inventing completed validation, measured results or a firm project decision absent from the speech. Luna to LLaMA, GPT 6.1 to GPT-4o/4.1, and deleting Sora are severe regardless of whether the source names seem unfamiliar. Turning a central question or proposed option into an asserted firm decision is severe; removing a small hedge without changing the question/decision is not.
criteria.uncertain: Cannot reliably decide whether an introduced difference is severe rather than a legitimate repair or slight nuance. Do not guess.
